summary: BI-BCBCA8D1. Preserve original scope, bounded real read provenance, advisory result and continuation history; attach the exact native Codex readers and hold incomplete contributions without unattested replay. No model, migration, retention-policy, persistent credential or grant change. Reuse immutable owned DocumentVersion/DocumentBlob captures; persist bounded server-only input-delivery hashes and version refs, never pixels in TaskRun metadata or prompt archives.

changes.retention: Inherit canonical TaskRun, engagement and Workroom retention; keep compact digests/ranges only, never raw source or credentials. Provided captures retain existing managed DocumentVersion/blob lifetime; later missing, restricted or corrupt content fails closed. No new retention ledger or policy.
